gitCommit.body:
fix(sorting): Epic R follow-ups — timebox cleanup, pass-budget reset, card height, curator-wide selectNextPair (#310)

* fix(rounds): drop dead timebox POST field + reset pass budget on goBack + tune RecommendedRoundCard height reservation

Fix 1 (purses-vrha): StartSessionForm POSTed a `timebox` field the
/api/sessions route never reads (it destructures only collectionId + goal;
round length is device-local via getRoundBox / setRoundBox). Dropped it from
the POST body; the round-length Select + setRoundBox persistence stay.

Fix 2 (purses-9kwd): UsageRound.goBack cleared claimed/newlyAnswered/handled
for a re-presented queued item but not its pass counter, so an item passed
once then answered then Back-ed would see seen=2 on a later Skip and drop
instead of cycling. Now resets passesRef for the re-presented item. Regression
test added (fails without the fix).

Fix 3 (purses-m72l): RecommendedRoundCard min-h-52 (208px) left visible dead
space at tablet/wide widths. Reduced to min-h-44 (176px) — covers the tallest
card content (label + h2 + 2-line description beside the h-11 CTA, ~136px on
the tablet-first sm:flex-row layout, plus p-5 padding) with headroom for the
zero-CLS primary->demoted swap, while trimming wide-width emptiness.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* fix(sorting): selectNextPair reads the curator-wide log so compare recommendation + round agree with the recompute across sessions (§7.3)

The compare recommendation (recommendNextRound) and the compare round page fed
selectNextPair a SESSION-scoped decision log, while the preference recompute uses
the curator-wide cross-session log. On a new session, a pair already ordered in a
prior session was re-offered/re-recommended (benign latest-wins, but redundant and
a mis-prediction of "compare available"). Feed selectNextPair the curator-wide log
in both places so the offered/recommended pair matches what the recompute needs
next (null -> decide). Recap + gentle count stay session-scoped via a filtered
subset of the same one curator-wide read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* refactor(rounds): responsive card min-h (phone zero-CLS) + drop dead NextRoundInput.decisions param

Review follow-ups: min-h-52 sm:min-h-44 keeps zero layout shift on phone while
trimming tablet dead space; NextRoundInput.decisions was unread after §7.3's
curator-wide selectNextPair fix — removed (SessionAnalytics keeps its own subset).
